text: Bitcoin is consolidating near $62k with modest gains while Ethereum's stronger 2.7% move suggests some selective risk appetite in alternative assets, though both majors remain under selling pressure. Extreme Fear sentiment and Bitcoin's elevated 55.6% dominance point to capital retreating from alts into perceived safety, despite the modest uptick in 7-day Fear & Greed momentum. Total volume of $66B is light for this price level, indicating neither conviction in recovery nor capitulation—more a hesitant pause before the next directional move.
